categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and sales of liquid crystal display modules (LCM) and capacitive touch panels (CTP) and their modules. It also engages in embedded product solutions and TFT LCD backend products. The business focuses on mid-to-small size interactive display solutions for industrial, medical, automotive, and IoT applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include TFT LCD display technology, capacitive touch panel technology, optical bonding, and embedded system software integration. The company develops advanced features such as 60G mmWave radar for gesture recognition, embedded heating for cold environments, NFC integration, 3D autostereoscopic touch displays, and water-tolerant touch technology. Manufacturing involves SMT, COB, TAB processes, and optical full lamination.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mainly from North America and Europe, serving industries such as industrial equipment, smart home devices, automotive displays, medical equipment, and commercial/office equipment. The company targets niche markets requiring customized, high-value display and touch solutions, including IoT, AIoT, and automotive smart cockpit applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, with significant business and subsidiaries in the United States, Europe (Denmark), Korea, Japan, and China (Dongguan). Sales are concentrated in Europe (54.29%), Americas (24.31%), Asia (11.30%), and other regions. Manufacturing is mainly in Taiwan and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the assembly and integration of display modules and touch panels. It sources upstream materials such as glass substrates, ITO targets, polarizers, and driver ICs from suppliers, and delivers finished modules downstream to OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in capacitive touch technology, development of non-contact control (3D gesture recognition), embedded AI vision systems, and integration of multi-functional sensors. The company invests heavily in R&D to enhance product differentiation, improve manufacturing efficiency, and expand embedded system solutions. Future R&D focuses on privacy display, haptic feedback, Wi-Fi integrated touch displays, and smart stylus technology.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of LCD modules, capacitive touch panels, and integrated touch-display modules. The company also earns income from embedded system solutions and licensing of patented technologies. Sales are made mostly on a contract/order basis to OEMs and distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading Taiwanese manufacturer specializing in mid-to-small size interactive display solutions with strong customization capabilities. It competes with global display and touch panel suppliers, emphasizing niche markets such as industrial, medical, automotive, and IoT applications. It differentiates through technology innovation, quality certifications, and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$4.69 billion, a 12.17% increase from the previous year, with net profit rising 77.55% to NT$420 million. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with EPS increasing to NT$2.83. Total assets reached NT$4.29 billion, and equity totaled NT$2.33 billion, reflecting a solid financial position and ongoing investment in capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customized interactive display solutions integrating capacitive touch and TFT LCD technologies. Unique value propositions include advanced gesture recognition, embedded AI vision, water-tolerant touch, and integrated NFC functionality. It offers comprehensive solutions combining hardware, software, and firmware to meet diverse customer needs in niche markets, ensuring high reliability, innovation, and enhanced user experience.
